description:
JEWELLED ME

• Brand introduction:
Welcome to the Jewelled Me Brand affiliate program! We are thrilled to have you on board and we appreciate your partnership with us.

We are a UK jewellery brand that specializes in necklaces that make every woman feel amazing. Our jewellery is more than just an accessory, it is a statement of who you are and how you want to be seen. Whether you are looking for something simple and elegant, or bold and dazzling, we have the perfect piece for you.

We are excited to collaborate with you and grow together.

• Product Description:
We offer two general types of jewellery, both of high quality and craftsmanship:

1. Gold plated: This includes our 14k & 18k gold-plated jewellery that has a luxurious shine and durability.

2. 925 Silver-based: This includes our 925 Sterling Silver & Gold Vermeil jewellery that has a classic elegance and versatility.

You can promote any of our products that suit your audience and style.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):
We take pride in our customer service and satisfaction. That’s why we have custom packaging and fast shipping for customers worldwide, so they can enjoy their jewellery as soon as possible. Our jewellery is also designed to look and feel amazing, with attention to detail and comfort.

Moreover, we are constantly expanding our product range to include custom jewellery pieces that you can personalize with your name, initials, or message. Stay tuned for this!

• Payment terms:
Payments will be made through PayPal or bank transfer, whichever you prefer.

• Other information:
We are here to support you and answer any questions you may have. We want to work as partners and help each other succeed.

If you have any ideas or suggestions on how we can improve our offer, our products, or our marketing, please let us know. We value your feedback and input.


We can't wait to work with you!
